pages.text: Written November 24. Where a number here differs from the card, the card is current as of today.
The back-tap hose timer
What happened
The timer on the back tap failed open twice in December. Each time it ran the drip line for about nine hours instead of twenty
minutes, and the raised bed flooded.
Date | Should have run | Ran for
December 4 | 20 minutes | about 9 hours
December 19 | 20 minutes | about 9 hours
The replacement
The same maker sells a two-outlet model for about 40 dollars. It fits the same tap thread and keeps the same schedule buttons.
Why now
The town's summer watering ban starts June 1. A timer that fails open during the ban is a fine, and the next failure is likely before
then.
Written November 24. Where a number here differs from the card, the card is current as of today.
A winter home for the spare bicycle
The spare bicycle stands against the garage door track, so the door stops a foot short of fully open.
The three places with room
Option | Cost | What it takes

cells: A. Wall hook in the garage
Two screws into the stud beside the shelves.

cells: The lawn mower has to move to the back wall.
pages.text: B. The shed | nothing | The lawn mower has to move to the back wall.

cells: A listing and one evening for the pickup.
pages.text: C. Sell it | brings in about 80 dollars | A listing and one evening for the pickup.
Nobody has ridden it since last spring.
Written November 24. Where a number here differs from the card, the card is current as of today.
House insurance renewal
The renewal
The policy renews on March 1. The insurer's letter says the premium will be "reviewed", and the new figure arrives in mid February.
Last year
The paper reminder arrived three days after the due date. The policy lapsed for two days before the payment cleared.
The two payment options
Automatic payment from the joint account on the renewal date. It can be cancelled online at any time, and a failed payment
sends an email.
Manual payment after the paper reminder, as today.
The paper reminder can stay on with either option.
